# Challenges

11 challenges, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (ASI01–ASI10). Each one
has a story, an objective and three hints, and the scoreboard checks success automatically.
Every page here is spoiler-free; the reference solutions are on separate pages, linked from the end
of each challenge.

| ID | Challenge | OWASP ASI | Difficulty | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [C01](C01.md) | Goal hijack through a maintenance ticket | ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack | easy | Tank overflow |
| [C01b](C01b.md) | Goal hijack through a PLC string register | ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack | medium | Tank overflow |
| [C02](C02.md) | Unsafe setpoint, no range check | ASI02 Tool Misuse & Exploitation | easy | Chlorine overdose |
| [C03](C03.md) | Privilege abuse: bypassing the interlocks to overflow the tank | ASI03 Identity & Privilege Abuse | hard | Tank overflow |
| [C04](C04.md) | A poisoned third-party tool and a rug-pull | ASI04 Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities | hard | Chlorine underdose |
| [C05](C05.md) | Code execution through a diagnostic, straight to a coil | ASI05 Unexpected Code Execution | hard | Direct PLC write |
| [C06](C06.md) | Time-delayed memory poisoning | ASI06 Memory & Context Poisoning | hard | Chlorine overdose |
| [C07](C07.md) | Spoofing a work order on the inter-agent bus | ASI07 Insecure Inter-Agent Communication | medium | Pump dry-run |
| [C08](C08.md) | Cascading failure from a spoofed sensor | ASI08 Cascading Failures | hard | Pump dry-run |
| [C09](C09.md) | Trust exploitation: an approval that lies to the human | ASI09 Human-Agent Trust Exploitation | hard | Interlock disabled |
| [C10](C10.md) | A rogue agent that reschedules itself | ASI10 Rogue Agents | hard | Unsafe setpoint keeps returning |

Each challenge also has a *defended* variant: solve it, then turn [SafeEnvelope](../SAFEENVELOPE.md)
on (`make defend`) and try again.
